transcriber_notes: Low-resolution (627x1200) SnowPro-style form (older layout, no branding) -> source_format 'other'. Printed date 06/03/2002 agrees with the file name. Height axis 2.374 px/cm (0 cm y938); boundaries from H-column lines/bar edges 255/247/230/219/211/176/159/150/123/120/108/97/54/45/37/14/0 (+-1 cm). Two dashed table rows; the second maps to the 255-247 cm layer (16 table rows for 16 bars). Hardness: bar widths on the non-linear axis agree with the R-column icons for every row. Several sizes use an italic '5' glyph ('5', '5-1', '1 5') that may be '.5' with an unrendered decimal point or a literal 5; not decoded (null + uncertain, literal in comment). HW/rho column: upper value HW, lower density (recorded). Temperatures: circles on 11.9 px/deg C (0 C at the 4F gridline x267, -20 at x29); the circle where the vertical dashed air line (-16.8 = printed air temp) meets the surface is not recorded; circles below 120 cm lie inside the hatched bars and were read visually (+-0.3 C); the 20/10/0 cm circles are not distinguishable.
